segment.unmapped: unique frame singleton; never collapse unknown frames by video

selection: Promote only if distinct-video R20 improves, MRR20 does not fall, and complete-target presence does not fall. Otherwise retain strongest supported parent; report exploratory gains without promotion.

reranker.gate: exact query, frame identity, model and input-context compatibility; skip if saved inference does not cover current candidate surface

semantic.provider: existing production BM25 k1=1.5 b=0.75 tokenizer and load_records
semantic.coverage_gate: at least one accepted video or required target missing from current pool recovered by mapped semantic top100
semantic.integration_if_gate_passes: fixed RRF k60 equal current and semantic provider; fixed 100-frame budget; no tuning

variants: quoted spans when present else canonical
query_variants.fusion: RRF k60 equal route weights; original canonical route retained

interpretation: Exploratory frozen benchmark; no pristine holdout claim. No query-specific tuning or manual query rewrites.
